resources.string:
- To win all goals must be hit (aqua squares)
 - You must move to a square that is the same color OR shape
 - You cannot move to squares behind you
 - You cannot move diagonally
 - You cannot move over blank squares
 - Moving off a goal will turn it into a blank square
 - Moves can be undone but will not be removed from the move count
